verdict.rationale: Navan's own pricing page lists "unlimited policy and approval workflows." Its MCP docs show transactions being automatically flagged or declined against policy and routed to approvers. Together these are a narrow form of admin-defined rules that fire actions when an expense or booking event occurs. The webhooks mention is only a developer building block, not user-defined automation, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: a general rule builder (custom triggers, conditions, arbitrary actions), documentation of how rules are configured, event types beyond policy/approval routing, AI-native or natural-language rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
